change: Smart Review diversity/deduplication fix and Learning Profile activity-panel spacing

findings.smart_review_bug: Previously generated Smart Review quizzes were themselves becoming tagged source-question candidates. Repeated review generation could therefore recursively duplicate the same question and let clones dominate a later review.
findings.ui_issue: The Learning Profile activity section used dashboard-panel without the page-specific padding applied to the other Learning Profile panels.

fixes: Exclude prior Smart Review quizzes from the source candidate pool.
De-duplicate candidate source questions by normalized question text.
Rotate selection across weak concepts before filling remaining slots.
Return fewer unique questions when fewer source questions exist instead of repeating content.
Exclude Smart Review clones from the displayed tagged-question inventory count.
Add scoped padding to the Learning Profile activity panel.
